references.text: This text provides detailed laws about menstrual impurity and its consequences for sexual intercourse, which form the basis of the prohibition in Leviticus 18:19.
The penalty for having sexual relations with a woman during her menstruation is described here – both shall be cut off from their people.
Ezekiel mentions keeping away from a woman during her impurity as a mark of a righteous man.
Ezekiel condemns those who dishonor women during their menstruation as part of Jerusalem's sins.
Describes impurity after childbirth compared to menstrual impurity, using the same terminology for uncleanness.
